links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and serious diagnostic errors (hallucinations) of chatbots on pathology descriptions
links.effect: Correct diagnoses on first attempt up to 82% (ChatGPT), 91% after follow-up prompt; serious diagnostic errors up to 9% (Gemini).
links.quote: Serious diagnostic errors ("hallucinations") occurred in as many as 9% of cases (Gemini).

links.outcome: Domain-specific clinical competency of general-purpose LLM chatbots in pathology
links.effect: Response quality varied among the four chatbots; up to 82% correct diagnoses first attempt; quality correlated with online documentation volume per pathology.
links.quote: Out of 200 texts submitted, response quality varied among the four CAs, with up to 82% (ChatGPT) of correct diagnoses on the first attempt (91% after a follow-up prompt).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating four commercial LLM conversational agents (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Mistral) on 200 standardized pathology text descriptions.
